# mAIth

> mAIth is an interactive learning platform for mathematics, physics, computer science, finance, and AI/ML, combining gamified quizzes with reference collections.

Canonical site: https://maith.lovable.app/

mAIth organizes technical learning into topic-based quizzes and supporting reference material. Public collections include formulas, glossary terms, influential thinkers, professional credential practice, a progressive knowledge vault, and a structured practice library.

## Canonical public pages

- [Home](https://maith.lovable.app/): Choose fields, topics, and difficulty levels and start a quiz.
- [Practice Library](https://maith.lovable.app/learn): Browse canonical field and topic practice pages with question coverage and direct quiz links.
- [Glossary](https://maith.lovable.app/glossary): Search technical terms and study definitions with mathematical notation and code where relevant.
- [Formulas](https://maith.lovable.app/formulas): Browse important equations with discoverers, history, domains, applications, and explanatory context.
- [Master Minds](https://maith.lovable.app/thinkers): Explore influential mathematicians, scientists, economists, computer scientists, and AI pioneers.
- [Bonafides](https://maith.lovable.app/bonafides): Practice quantitative professional certification and credential topics.
- [Vault](https://maith.lovable.app/vault): Explore progressively unlocked STEM and AI knowledge challenges.
- [Leaderboard](https://maith.lovable.app/leaderboard): View public quiz rankings and scores.

## Learning page hierarchy

Canonical standard-practice routes use:

- `/learn/{field-slug}` for field landing pages.
- `/learn/{field-slug}/{topic-slug}` for focused topic practice pages.

Topic and field pages are generated from the canonical content registry. Thin topic pages remain accessible but are excluded from indexing until their question coverage reaches the configured SEO quality floor.

## Content organization

Quiz content is grouped by field, topic, and difficulty. Reference content is kept in dedicated collections rather than mixed into ordinary quiz taxonomy. Search query parameters on glossary and formula pages are filters; the canonical pages are the clean URLs listed above.

## Non-canonical utility pages

Authentication, onboarding, personal profile, and unknown routes are utility pages and are not intended for search indexing.
